title: NASA Announces $20 Billion Plan for 3 Moon Base Missions & Blue Moon Lander
summary: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman unveils Moon Base I, II & III plan selecting Blue Origin's Blue Moon Mark 1 lander for permanent lunar infrastructure.

blocks.content: NASA unveiled a **$20 billion 3-phase Moon Base roadmap** selecting Blue Origin's Blue Moon lander to establish a permanent human settlement on the Moon's South Pole by 2028.

provenance.sourceTitle: NASA Announces $20 Billion Plan for 3 Moon Base Missions & Blue Moon Lander
